glossary.definition: A core Chemceed inventory/costing object used to track quantities, costs, lot-related activity, and downstream reporting such as Venture Analysis and Gross Margin Detail.
Chemceed’s build/repack/blend workflow for creating new inventory outputs from existing materials, including costs, assemblies, packages, and venture tracking.
A Chemceed-specific custom report/tool used to estimate pricing and profitability using Quote, Product, and Sourcing data, with custom formulas and rounding behavior.
Certificate of Analysis functionality used for specification comparison, customer-specific requirements, purchase specs, and document generation.
Standard specification data tied to products/purchase-side logic rather than customer-specific requirements.
Customer-specific product requirements used in Chemceed’s COA/spec workflows.
Bill of Lading document with Chemceed-specific logic for HazMat, BOL Description, NMFC, Shipping Class, gross weight, pickup address, and shipment/delivery usage.
Document/report related to shipment arrival at warehouse, customized for Chemceed with lot/package fields and related logistics details.
Chemceed document output populated from shipment, warehouse, vendor, and ship-to related logic including pickup and delivery details.
Delivery-level memo field displayed on Chemceed packing lists.
Explicit contact selected by users in Quote, Opportunity, or Sales Order workflows and used for document/email population.
Explicit vendor-side contact used in Sourcing or PO-related workflows and generated emails.
Customer-requested field used in Quote, SO, and PO-related document logic instead of or in addition to default ship-via behavior.
Chemceed-specific memo fields intended to roll from Quote to Sales Order in certain workflows.
Memo field on Quote Price and Payment Terms tab for Chemceed-specific sourcing context.
Quote-level Chemceed field used for resolution tracking.
Quote-level memo field used to capture feedback context.
PO document behavior where a blind shipment can suppress normal ship-to display and instead show CPU or alternate logic.
Specific PO document display behavior used when Blind is selected.
Chemceed purchase-order workflow field extending PO status with customer-specific operational stages such as Pending COA, On the water, or CBP Hold.
User-related filtering concept used in scans; Chemceed wanted prefilter behavior without permanently restricting visibility.
Chemceed-specific prefiltered order view using prepared-by or user-related logic.
Important Chemceed reporting surface used to analyze venture-level profitability and cost allocation.
Accounting/inventory report discussed in Chemceed training and accounting workflows.
A major Chemceed cost concept, often tied to packages, inventory uploads, ventures, and cost allocations.
Area where Chemceed tracks estimated costs, often before actual costs are converted or posted.
Desired Chemceed functionality for turning estimated cost behavior into actual cost records.
A Chemceed logistics concept that evolved across several projects, eventually becoming a shipment/vendor-driven workflow rather than a simple PO field.
Vendor-side structure for tracking both manufacturer and pickup-related address information.
Chemceed custom Sales Order field extending status handling on the SO side.
Customer/vendor grouping concept that Chemceed wanted as a multi-select or equivalent custom-field solution.
Chemceed-preferred label replacing Product Group for reporting/grouping purposes.
Chemceed-preferred label replacing Weight per Carton in product and purchasing workflows.
Product-level field driving BOL and related output logic.
Product-level field used on Chemceed BOL documents, especially for hazardous materials.
Product-level field mapped to BOL class output.
Product-level field mapped to BOL NMFC output.
Product-level GHS-related field where Chemceed wanted blank values to display as None.
Customer upload type used when Active = No and Type = Lead.
